task.title: Enter motor details
task.shortdesc: This section describes how to enter motor information in the .

context.p: This section describes how to enter motor information in the .
The can accurately learn and monitor the motor's operation using this information. The motor’s nameplate contains key information that allows the to effectively analyze its performance.
If you have completed the Motor Information Form, use it for quick entry. Alternatively, see How to read a motor plate.
To enter details of the motor:

step.cmd: After the is connected to the via the Wi-Fi network, tap Set up motor details now.

info.note: If you want to perform this step later, then tap Save for later .

fig.title: Screens explaining how to enter motor details

step.cmd: In the next screen, enter details of the motor to which you want to attach the .
Start by adding a photo of the motor and its nameplate.

ul.li: Motor name (TAG): Identification of the motor
Manufacturer: Enter manually if it does not appear on the list

info.note: The features some pre-filled data. Tap the relevant field to change this information, if needed.

info.p: Based on the data provided, the displays more information about the motor. You can edit this information, if needed.

step.cmd: Enter the De Bearing and nDE Bearing numbers and the Bearing Manufacturer.

ul.li: De Bearing and nDE Bearing numbers are a four-digit Industry Standard Number for low-voltage induction motors. Both numbers can either be the same or different from each other. Examples include 6321 or NU303.
The following table describes the acceptable and invalid inputs for bearing numbers:

row.entry: Accepted range of bearing numbers: 6202-6228 6302-6328 Accepted range for NU series bearings: NU203-NU228 NU303-NU328
Entering a single digit Adding variable letters at the end, for example, 6313ZZ Entering numbers with forward slashes, for example, 6321/56C Entering words such as UNKNOWN or MISSING

ul.li: If you don’t have the Bearing Manufacturer information, leave this field blank and do not enter the motor manufacturer.
If you don’t have the De Bearing and nDE Bearing numbers, leave these fields blank.

info.note: Bearing models are required to identify potential problems and to enable the Bearing Health category analytics.
info.p: If you do not enter the De Bearing and nDE Bearing numbers, the Bearing Health category analytics will be disabled.
